name: wmkf_requestdocument-post-presentation-materials
_comment: Additive external-URL and slot-fence fields for post-presentation materials. Runtime must not select or write them until exact preflight, explicit apply, and POST_PRESENTATION_MATERIALS_SCHEMA_READY=on. Readiness alone does not authorize feature access; POST_PRESENTATION_MATERIALS_ACCESS remains separate and defaults off.

attributes.description: Governed server-written external URL for a post-presentation material, including a Zoom recording link. Never project this field directly to external clients.
Positive monotonic fence for the request and post-presentation artifact slot.
